recommendation.rationale: BP 154/91 on amlodipine alone is above the <130/80 goal, so therapy should be intensified. With CKD (eGFR 42) an ACE inhibitor (or ARB) is the preferred addition; potassium 4.8 is below the 5.5 threshold and she is not pregnant and has no angioedema history, so no contraindication applies.

trace.detail: Readings 156/92 and 152/90 summarize to 154/91, at or above 140/90 -> stage 2.
Already on one antihypertensive (amlodipine) with BP above the <130/80 goal -> intensify pharmacotherapy.
CKD (eGFR 42 < 60) makes ACEI or ARB the preferred class to add.
Potassium 4.8 < 5.5, not pregnant, no angioedema history -> no contraindication to ACEI/ARB.
